I farm a small piece of land here in the South South, just this small 0.05 hectare for my root crops — mostly cassava with some cocoyam. Chemical fertilizer is expensive and for cassava it doesn't really pay, so I will not buy it this season; instead I will spread the household manure and kitchen waste I have been collecting. I plant cuttings from my last harvest like my mother taught me, and I weed by hand with help from my children — no need for sprays or hired hands on such a small plot.
